findingDetails.title: Codex opens the caller's locator after containment resolved a different path
findingDetails.claim: loadCodexSession records containment.path as source.storePath but reads the bytes from transcriptPath, so the checked file and the opened file can differ.
findingDetails.scopeProof: rg -n "readFileSync\(transcriptPath" .skilled/hooks/shared/session-readers returns only codex.mjs:167; claude.mjs:219, devin.mjs:356 and dsh.mjs:313 read storePath.

findingDetails.title: The OpenCode top-only request can strip the head command from the first passing row
findingDetails.claim: compiledRouteTopOnly enriches index 0 only, while the renderer leads with the first passing row; a failing row 0 spends the lookup and a passing row 1 leads without its command.
findingDetails.scopeProof: system-skill-advisor.js:858 sends the option; advisor-recommend.ts:462 returns early for index > 0; render.ts:530-540 takes the first passing row.

title: The OpenCode top-only request can strip the head command from the first passing row
claim: compiledRouteTopOnly enriches index 0 only, while the renderer leads with the first passing row; a failing row 0 spends the lookup and a passing row 1 leads without its command.

direction: The prompt cache can carry a lower-row command into a top-only request
reason: the cache stores the un-enriched parsed output (advisor-recommend.ts:693-699) and re-runs enrichment on every hit, so no route command is inherited

direction: The plugin selects row 0 when no row passes and renders the wrong head
reason: the renderer filters to zero passing rows and returns null, so the plugin emits the no-match fallback

direction: A custom tool call with both arguments '{}' and input loses the body today
reason: Codex's custom_tool_call schema carries input and no arguments; the fixture matches that, so no current producer reaches the edge

detail: correctness/security pass: two P2 findings, both reachable; four same-class readers compared; the cache and threshold disagreement directions ruled out with evidence
